payload.summary: The meeting ends with a sentence no one can later pretend they misunderstood.
payload.body: The meeting ends with a sentence no one can later pretend they misunderstood. Mercury conjunct Saturn can make the wording and the consequence part of the same official fact, especially in a signed statement, formal warning, binding promise, or documented refusal. The clarity may feel strict, but it protects everyone from a later version of what was supposedly meant. Put the condition, date, responsibility, and consequence in writing. If the answer matters, it should survive being read again next month.
